component.name: DiskMD
component.summary: Drive health for Linux, in plain English

description.p: SMART data made readable. diskmd checks every drive in your PC, explains in plain English whether it is healthy, and tells you what to do about it. USB enclosures are detected automatically.

ul.li: Plain-English verdicts per drive: healthy, watch, warning or failing
Link speed check: spots an SSD stuck on a USB 2.0 port or an NVMe running at x2
Kernel I/O error scan, SMART self-tests and a KDiskMark-style speed test
Wear, temperature and write-rate trends, with optional daily background alerts
Used-drive check for signs of reset or altered SMART counters
Shareable report with serial numbers left out

description.p: diskmd only reads SMART data. It never writes to or reconfigures a drive. The speed test writes one temporary file inside a mounted filesystem and deletes it.
